subject: computer-science
title: Algorithm Efficiency and Big O
welcome_lead: Measure how fast algorithms scale with input size using Big O notation.
meta_desc: CS adventure on algorithm complexity, Big O analysis and common orders.
final_note: Big O describes growth, ignoring constants and low-order terms!
